title: Improvement of a Physically Active Lifestyle
brief_summary: To help rehabilitation patients to adopt and maintain a physically active lifestyle, it is imperative to increase self-management competencies. Aim of this research project is to evaluate an evidence- and theory-based computerized expert system in comparison to a well established standard program and a questionnaire-only group. Rehabilitation patients will be treated psychologically and followed up over 18 months. The computerized expert system is expected to help patients better than the standard program. Both interventions are hypothesized to improve self-management competencies over and above the rehabilitation treatment (i.e., questionnaire-only group).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* to be capable of exercising on their own at the minimum level recommended by the according rehabilitation clinic
* able to fill out a questionnaire (no illiteracy)
* adequate German language ability

Exclusion Criteria:

* the participant not be of age
* severe cognitive deficits
* visual impairments (patients have to read at the PC)
